description: This file defines the TasksController class, providing REST API endpoints for managing tasks within a project management system. It includes methods for creating, updating, retrieving, deleting, and bulk operations on task entities, leveraging Entity Framework Core for database interactions.

classes.name: TasksController
classes.description: Controller class providing RESTful API endpoints for CRUD operations and bulk operations on task entities.

methods.name: CreateOne
methods.description: Creates a new task, assigns the creator, logs an audit action, saves changes, and returns the created task.

methods.name: UpdateOne
methods.description: Updates an existing task identified by ID with new data, excluding the ID from modifications.

methods.name: GetMany
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tasks filtered by optional query parameters like limit, projectId, priority, and status.

methods.name: GetOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single task by ID, including related user information, or returns 404 if not found.

methods.name: DeleteOne
methods.description: Deletes a task by ID, logs the delete action, and returns 404 if the task does not exist.

methods.name: PatchMany
methods.description: Performs bulk update or delete operations on multiple tasks based on provided IDs and operation type.
